name: Card Blueprints
description: Card Blueprints, published by Cassidy Rice, turns a date of birth into Cardology coordinates: the fixed playing-card birth card in a 52-card pattern language. This is not fortune-telling and not tarot. The free skill is a deep-link calculator. Paid personal reading ordered directly on the page: The Card Blueprint Reading ($99) — instant Suggested Questions download after payment plus 48 hours of access to submit up to 3 questions (solo timing or two people's cards read together by Cass), delivered by email or text message within 48 hours (almost all under 24 hours). This card is a discovery manifest; skills are public HTTPS pages, not an A2A JSON-RPC task server.
